column1: # The state each PR was in when it was reviewed.
# `./bench followup` diffs this against GitHub and reports what moved: a new
# push by the author, a maintainer comment, a merge, a close. Without a recorded
# head SHA there is no way to answer "has this changed since I looked", which is
# the question a second visit actually asks.
# Update a row only when you have re-read the PR at its new head. Rewriting it
# to silence `followup` throws away the thing being tracked.
# verdict   take | changes | blocked | stale-approval | routine | none
#             blocked         would break users; do not merge as-is
#             stale-approval  approved, then the branch grew
#             routine         bot or maintainer work, no review needed
# posted    yes | no      has the comment in the review file been posted upstream
